title: HSK 2.0 Phase 2 Independent Data QA, Verification & Flaw Remediation
description: Comprehensive audit and remediation of 7 previous session flaws, phonotactic pinyin validation with pypinyin dictionary cross-check, elimination of English fallbacks across 1,200 vocabulary items, pedagogical translation of 311 grammar points, record-level diff engine with 5-category classification, database lock and signed token approval gate, and positive/negative test suites.
acceptance_criteria: Audit and remediate 7 flaws from previous implementation session with file/line evidence
Strict Pinyin phonotactic validation and pypinyin dictionary cross-check with 0 errors on 1,200 vocab items
Eliminate 100% of English fallback strings and uncleaned parentheses in Vietnamese meanings
Pedagogical translation of 311 grammar points with formulas and multi-sentence examples
Explain Hanban 2012 syllabus word count target anomaly (150, 150, 299, 601 = 1,200 cumulative entries)
Implement record-level diff engine categorizing all records into TO_ADD, TO_UPDATE, UNCHANGED, CONFLICT, SUPPLEMENTARY
Implement database safety approval gate requiring cryptographic/signed token prior to writes
Implement both Positive Suite (7 tests) and Negative Tamper Suite (4 tests) with 11/11 PASS
Verify regression tests: 38/38 .NET backend unit tests and 288/288 bun frontend unit tests PASS
Compile 5 detailed markdown documentation deliverables in docs/hsk20/
safety_constraints: Zero database writes (Dev strictly read-only, Test locked with signed token gate)
No copyrighted books or audio files committed to Git repository
Preserve 70 lessons architecture with single HSK 4 level (no HSK 4A/4B split)
Keep PR #16 Open/Draft; do not merge or force push
